fable-forest.$description: Fable Forest — Full-bleed dark section background, first-screen hero band — deep botanical green that makes the warm cream and orange illustration pop

storybook-sky.$description: Storybook Sky — Full-bleed mid section background — cerulean blue band that carries product-feature storytelling between cream and green sections

paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary heading and display text — near-black with a violet undertone that warms the editorial serif without losing contrast

charcoal-plum.$description: Charcoal Plum — Filled pill button background, dark card surfaces, secondary heading color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, paragraph copy, secondary UI text — warm dark gray that reads softer than pure black on cream

char.$description: Char — Footer background, darkest surface — reserved for terminal bands and footer chrome

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page background, reverse-mode button fill (on dark sections), text on dark surfaces

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle image placeholders, soft dividers, muted card backgrounds when a lighter neutral than cream is needed

inter.$description: All UI, body, button, link, and supporting text. Negative letter-spacing across the scale tightens Inter into an editorial companion to Heldane — at 16px body the tracking reads noticeably tighter than default. Weights 400 for body, 500 for labels/buttons, 600–700 reserved for emphasis.

heldane-display.$description: Editorial display headlines at 48–80px. Near-regular weight (400) with tight tracking and compressed line-heights creates a literary, magazine-cover feel — the headline is the hero, not a shout. The 22–26px usage at weight 500 handles mid-size editorial subtitles.

aktiv-grotesk.$description: Aktiv Grotesk — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
